title: Local cokernel presentation without finite source
statement: An extension as in lem-pc-constant-extension-cokernel-presentation admits a local cokernel presentation, without the finite generation clause.

source.place: Tag 093U, Lemma 18.43.5 extension argument, pushout diagram

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-constant-extension-presentation-lift to obtain an etale cover and, on each member, a short exact module presentation T of the quotient together with the lifted map r and its commuting equation. No cokernel assertion is assumed at this step.

Map S by etale inverse image and T by the constant-sheaf functor. Both functors preserve finite limits and colimits. In the proved private Lean helper extension_presentation, use exactness of S to factor T.f followed by r as g followed by S.f. Put d = (-g,T.f) and q = [S.f,r]. The relation d followed by q is zero. Epi cancellation in the two original short exact sequences proves q epi; kernel lifting and mono cancellation prove that d is its kernel. Thus the cokernel of d is the middle term. This entire categorical argument is proved in Lean.

Choose a constant model M for S_1. The natural isomorphism upperStarConstantSheafIso identifies its restriction with the constant sheaf M. Preservation of binary coproducts identifies constant(M plus T_2) with the biproduct used above. Postcompose d with the inverse of this isomorphism and use cokernel.mapIso to obtain the required cokernel presentation.
